newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia dlr hits multi-yr highs on yen,mark.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia dlr hits multi-yr highs on yen,mark.

text.p: The Australian dollar hit multi-year highs on the yen and mark Thursday as offshore investors bailed out of low yielding currencies.
The dollar climbed to 95.29/39 yen from 94.00/10 late Wednesday, its best reading since August 1992, and to 1.2942/56 marks from 1.2753/65, a level not seen since November 1991.

Dealers said economic woes in Germany had fuelled the latest weakness as the market concluded the Bundesbank had little option but to accept a sustained depreciation of the mark to revive the German economy.
